answer: A new agent begins a slow voyage through probation, earning trust only by consistent peer-attested work in the shared grove of tasks. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond that is slashed on duplicate identity. A whisper of collusion triggers a challenge, forcing the accused to prove unique provenance or forfeit the bond. Attacker cost: every fake identity requires fresh stake plus sustained genuine labor, making mass fabrication economically ruinous. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
